round4_root_cause: warm_service computed its four gates, then plan_service asserted binding['qualification']['pass_'] before computing its remaining four. The generated fresh binding had no qualification block. Legacy lscollect1/warm staging supplies passing qualification receipts from an earlier qualifier; that format cannot be used as fresh-worker evidence.

fresh_qualification.binding_block: qualification = {mode:'fresh_startup_v1', pass_:false, status:'pending', required:[all eight hotadd.GATES], receipts:{}, source_hashes:<binding hashes>, receipt:'FRESH_QUALIFICATION.json', new_sumo_sim_s:0}
fresh_qualification.immutable_contract: GPU_BINDING.json remains immutable and pending on disk. It declares the required fresh qualification and the completed receipt location; it NEVER claims a pre-passed qualification. plan_service builds the actual qualification block in memory from worker-owned receipts before READY.
fresh_qualification.begin: warm_service calls fresh_worker.begin before model bootstrap. Requires the exact pending contract, verifies every pinned source hash and the worker environment, refuses adopted_startup_gates or any existing startup/final qualification evidence, and exclusively writes FRESH_STARTUP.json with this PID, binding SHA256 and actual environment metadata.
fresh_qualification.first_four: warm_service computes COMMITTED K4/H300, K8/H420 and WARM_BATCH_SINGLE K4/H120, K8/H300. Each fresh gate records this process PID. plan_service loads GPU_BINDING.json through its real reader, verifies those four exact passing gates against FRESH_STARTUP.json's process/binding identity, and permits only the remaining startup checks. Qualification is still pass_:false/status:running at this point.
fresh_qualification.last_four: plan_service computes PARITY K4/H120, K8/H300 and WARM_PARITY K4/H120, K8/H300. Before SERVICE_OWNER/READY it aggregates all eight actual receipts, requiring pass_ is true, max_cost_error == 0 and the current PID on every gate. Only then is qualification pass_:true/status:passed and FRESH_QUALIFICATION.json exclusively published.
fresh_qualification.completed_receipt: Contains the complete qualification block: all required gates and their receipt payloads, source_hashes, PID, binding_sha256, actual host environment, and zero new SUMO sim-s.
fresh_qualification.no_receipt_inheritance: Explicit source bindings containing a prior passing qualification refuse. The staging script refuses overlay STARTUP gates, owner/lock files, FRESH_STARTUP.json, FRESH_QUALIFICATION.json and any overlay GPU_BINDING.json before creating the worker root. Existing roots still refuse; no process is adopted or signalled.
fresh_qualification.source_pins: Generated hashes include the prior numerical and variety source sets plus fresh_worker.py, warm_service.py, warm_spool.py and hotadd.py. Every hash is verified against the overlay and copied tree. Operator-supplied bindings still pin their explicitly registered source inventory.
fresh_qualification.legacy: Bindings without fresh_startup_v1 retain plan_service's existing qualification pass_ assertion and the existing warm/adopted-service flow. Fresh-only helpers are imported only on the new path.

config_keys.policies_root: Other root holding read-only B_checkpoint_<k>.pt and R_checkpoint_<k>.pt
config_keys.checkpoint_k / checkpoint_k_B / checkpoi: One nonnegative pinned k for both arms; mismatches refuse
config_keys.checkpoint_sha256: Required map B/R -> sha256; checked before any charge
config_keys.charge_route: Required registered phases and run_root. mode rpc (default): q_host/q_control/q_python/q_pythonpath; mode local: only on registered LEDGER_HOST.json host/path/authority SHA
config_keys.collect_id_prefix / episode_phase: Registered parameterised episode ID prefix and charge phase
config_keys.extra_seeds: Default 0; nonnegative live per_seed_v1 extra-seed option passed to all8_both_seeds confirmations
config_keys.variety: Registered variety_* options; off/absent keeps legacy behavior
config_keys.broker: Single-slot endpoint+owner broker config with amendment_sha256, gpu_deadline, optional source binding and optional explicit worker_env
config_keys.gpu_host: gpuA or gpuR, also settable with --gpu-host; default inferred from the broker slot prefix. Selection must agree with the slot. Nonstandard slot labels require explicit host selection.
config_keys.broker.worker_env: Optional complete explicit host-image pin: host, python_executable, python_version (major.minor), torch_version (full build), cuda_version, variables. Allows the registered installed image to be pinned explicitly rather than using collector metadata. Must agree with gpu_host.

worker_environment.gpuA: Default GPU contract above; memory_fraction .42 and batch_width_by_K {'4':18,'8':10}, following hotadd.binding's host-specific geometry
worker_environment.gpuR: Default GPU contract above; memory_fraction .34 and widths {'4':4,'8':4}. If the installed gpuR image differs, register the complete broker.worker_env for that image before staging. No remote image inspection was performed.
worker_environment.recording: gpu_host and worker_env are recorded in GPU_BINDING.json and the generated broker/script config. Actual metadata is recorded in FRESH_STARTUP.json and the completed qualification.
worker_environment.enforcement: STAGE_WORKER probes the pinned interpreter's Python/Torch/CUDA build metadata before creating the root, refuses mismatches, and launches that interpreter with pinned variables. fresh_worker.begin rechecks interpreter realpath, package metadata and variables in the actual service process before bootstrap. No CUDA initialization is needed for these metadata checks.
worker_environment.cpu_collector: The collector's CPU Python/Torch versions are never used to generate the default GPU contract. CPU tests explicitly supply their own test-only host-image pin.

preserved_collection_contract.policies: Same coop3 V2V builder: strict v2v_runtime.load_checkpoint with v2v_launch3.INTENT_OPTIONS; plain checkpoints retain accel_learner.load
preserved_collection_contract.observations: V2V episode keys and bank_v2v.enabled around branch verification/confirmation; policy_wm uses the matching widened actor and neutral absent-partner columns
preserved_collection_contract.ledger: Exactly one ledger, rpc/local registered route; no collection-root CHARGES.jsonl
preserved_collection_contract.fairness: R waits for the matching B decision and inherits its available_k, by design
preserved_collection_contract.variety: B floor(.25N) structured slots; R Bernoulli(.25) unscored mix; GPU binding enables niche_comparison so plan_service accepts the registered search_config
preserved_collection_contract.admission: Broker and generated --check require every hotadd.GATES receipt to pass; failed/missing gates never admit the slot

how_to_run: Stage this commit's CPU and GPU package overlay using the existing operator workflow. Register the one ledger host and collect RPC phases/prefixes or use local mode only on that registered host.

Create the new collection root and VARCOLLECT_CONFIG.json. Pin both coop3 checkpoint SHAs at the same k, register the episode phase and variety keys, and configure the single intended GPU endpoint/slot.

For gpuA, stage the B artifacts with: python -B -m tools.coopmwm.varcollect <collection_root> --arm B --gpu-host gpuA. gpu_host can instead be recorded in VARCOLLECT_CONFIG.json. R uses --arm R with the same policy/ledger contracts.
Review the generated fresh.binding.worker_env and host-specific geometry. A different GPU image requires a complete explicit broker.worker_env; do not substitute cpuS package versions.

Operator only: assemble an overlay with the pinned sources under pytools/ and existing observable runtime artifacts at top level (INPUTS.json, FROZEN_COSTS.json, FROZEN_MOTION_SOURCE.py, wmteach runtime). Supply no owner, gate or qualification receipts.

Operator only, on the selected GPU host: python3 broker/STAGE_WORKER.py <NEW_worker_root> --overlay <overlay_dir>. The script probes and uses the pinned worker interpreter, stages a new root, and starts the fresh warm_spool service locally.

Poll broker/STAGE_WORKER.py <worker_root> --overlay <overlay_dir> --check. Require all eight gates plus SERVICE_OWNER/READY and the passing FRESH_QUALIFICATION.json from this new process. Install BROKER_CONFIG.json as LS_ENDPOINTS.json next to the registered LS_RECOVERY_CONFIG.json and use the existing broker entrypoint.
MAIN_STOP.json stops collection after the current round. Retain failed/partial worker roots for inspection; a fresh launch always needs a new root.
